Canada continues to be one of the top destinations for individuals seeking permanent residency (PR), and the Express Entry system remains a key pathway to achieving that goal. Launched in 2015, Express Entry is an online immigration management system designed to streamline the process for skilled workers, professionals, and entrepreneurs to gain PR in Canada.
